title: Seasonal Biodiversity Index
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=birdnet:detection OR sourcetype=trailcam:detection OR sourcetype=mothtrap:capture)
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats dc(species) as species by _time
| sort - _time
description: Combines birds, mammals, and moths into a monthly count of distinct species, a single index of your patch's biodiversity.
value: A combined species index across taxa is a powerful, motivating measure of whether your rewilding or planting is working.
implementation: Ingest detections across sensors into `index=personal`; schedule monthly and count total distinct species.
visualization: Line chart of monthly distinct species across all sensors.
grandmaExplanation: It combines birds, animals, and insects into one monthly count of how many species share your garden.
